# Path-building bound vectors, generated with Go crypto/x509 (ECDSA P-256, validity 2020-01-01..2099-12-31).
#  flood_*  - 40 self-issued fillers all named X (distinct keys), flood_leaf issued by X under a key no certificate holds,
#             flood_anchor an unrelated trust anchor: the chain reaches nothing trusted and path building must give up fast.
#  ring_*   - four subjects A,B,C,D in a ring (A issued by B, B by C, C by D, D by A), each with three self-issued
#             certificates plus the one cross-issued certificate; ring_leaf is issued by A; ring_anchor is unrelated.
#  order_*  - order_anchor (root R) issues order_real (subject Order X); order_decoy_0/1 are self-issued Order X with junk
#             keys; order_leaf is issued by the real Order X key. Whether the chain validates depends only on presentation order.
